perks.name: License to Thrill
perks.description: Activating your grenade or the Nanotech Tracer Missiles Origin Trait provides stacking resistance to incoming damage at point-blank range.
perks.exact:
On Grenade Ability Usage, or upon triggering either the Nanotech Tracer Missile Origin Trait or Quicksilver Storm's Missile Tracer: 
Grants a stack of License to Thrill for 15 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
Buff duration is refreshed upon retriggering.

License to Thrill | 12% [2%] Damage Resist against enemies within <5 metres, increased by +?% [?%] per stack afterwards, up to 30% [5%] Damage Resist.

perks.name: Lethal Weave
perks.description: Defeating an unraveled combatant grants grenade ability energy. If you have max grenade energy, you are granted Special ammo meter progress instead.
perks.exact:
On Unraveled Enemy Kill:
10% Grenade Ability Energy.
+10% Special Ammo Progress if at maximum Grenade Ability Energy.
